text: {"headline":"Documented Review of March 2026 Tooling Award and Related Advisory Fee","overview":"This brief summarizes calibrated document records concerning the 4 March 2026 tooling contract award, competing bids, scoring, and a subsequent advisory fee, alongside conflicting register dates and unverified reporter observations. It distinguishes documented records from reporter allegations and notes unresolved temporal inconsistencies.","key_points":["On 4 March 2026, PERSON_1 awarded the tooling contract to Fenlock Supply [C001]","Fenlock's quote was $186,000 and the next compliant bid was $174,500 [C002, C003]","The scoring sheet gives Fenlock nine delivery points, but the promised lead time is six weeks in both bids [C004, C005]","Brindle Advisory's invoice says 'market access advice' and has no hours or deliverables, and the vendor declaration lists the same family address as the director's conflict form [C006, C007, C008]","Documented records state that two days later PERSON_1 approved a $12,400 advisory fee to his sibling's firm Brindle Advisory, the following Monday Nessa Corven put the advisory invoice on hold for review, and in early April PERSON_1 asked accounts payable to release the held fee [C009, C010, C011]","After the audit Nessa Corven moved the vendor folder into restricted storage, while the 2 March approval register says PERSON_1 released the fee after the review, creating an unresolved temporal conflict among these dated records [C012, C013]","The purchase order covers actual tooling still needed, the authorization and settlement fields are separate, and a document notes this is a relationship flag, not proof of a payment to the director [C014, C015, C021]","The reconciliation packet as of 2026-04-10 lists an advisory fee on hold of $12,400, consistent with the hold record [C022, C010]","The reporter alleges noticing the advisory charge because the receiving record was blank, asking for work product and getting a forwarded invoice, not seeing money change hands, and no longer having access to the vendor folder; these remain unverified reporter allegations without independent document support and are presented alongside documented invoice details [C017, C018, C019, C020, C006]"],"risk_notes":["Vendor declaration address match to director's conflict form is documented as a relationship flag, explicitly noted as not proof of payment to the director [C008, C021]","Scoring advantage on delivery points despite identical six-week lead times in both bids raises a documented inconsistency for review [C004, C005]","Movement of vendor folder to restricted storage after audit limits further independent verification [C012]"],"limitations":["Evidence does not show independent proof of payment to the director, intent, or completion of settlement; authorization and settlement are recorded as separate fields [C015, C021]","Temporal sequence among the advisory fee approval, hold, and release register entries is contradictory and unresolved [C009, C010, C013]","Reporter observations about receiving records, work product requests, and access lack verified document support and remain unverifiable [C017, C018, C019, C020]","Evidence does not establish whether the held advisory fee was ultimately settled or released after 10 April 2026 beyond conflicting register entries [C013, C022]"]}
